The bisect to `aa6ba0623` does not hold: the SAME SHA passed the merge-driver gate in its merge-group run at 17:21Z (job 101339073624, step ran ~17:21Z) and failed in its push run at 17:26Z (job 101343111648); every run in every lane whose step executed after ~17:22Z fails identically, on trees that passed minutes earlier. Environmental root cause, reproduced locally: `check-regen-pending.mjs --self-test` writes a throwaway fixture with no `packageManager` and runs `pnpm -s` in it; under Corepack an unpinned project resolves the registry's `latest` dist-tag, which now reads `pnpm@12.3.4`, and that CLI rejects `-s` (exit 2) — the "clean" stub never runs, so the discharge case and the three prerequisite cases go red. `aa6ba0623` merely happened to be the first push after the tag moved. Fix: the fixture carries the root's `packageManager` pin (PR #16002, reviewed, auto-merge armed, `Fixes #15994` added so this card closes with it). First-filed anchor is #15990 (17:44Z); #15992 carries the seat's reproduction.
